preconditions.description: The number of chairs n must be between 2 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= s <= n and 1 <= e <= n and s != e
preconditions.description: The starting position s and ending position e must be valid chair indices and must not be the same.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All chair coordinates x must be positive and within the range of 1 to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n)) and all(1 <= b[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n)) and all(1 <= c[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n)) and all(1 <= d[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All values in arrays a, b, c, and d must be positive and within the range of 1 to 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum time required for Scott to visit all chairs and reach Cross.
